request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, double bass, muted trumpet, slow and reflective, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How can a young man keep his path pure
By guarding it according to your word
With all my heart I seek you now
Do not let me stray from your commandments

[Chorus]
I have stored up your word in my heart
So that I may not sin against you
Your law is the light of my feet
Guiding me through the night

[Verse]
I will thank you with an upright heart
As I learn your righteous judgments
I will keep your statutes close
Do not utterly forsake me here

[Chorus]
I have stored up your word in my heart
So that I may not sin against you
Your law is the light of my feet
Guiding me through the night

[Bridge]
Blessed are you Lord teach me your statutes
With my lips I recount all the judgments
In the way of your testimonies I rejoice
As over all riches in the world

[Chorus]
I have stored up your word in my heart
So that I may not sin against you
Your law is the light of my feet
Guiding me through the night

[Outro]
Guarding it according to your word
My heart is safe within your law
